review: Static ownership/state audit, no inference claim
checked: Prefix scope is a fixed-length capability; shared lookup selects published exact token prefixes only.
Shared entries are immutable; MatchShared acquires a lease through Restore. model_mu serializes transfers and destination scratch.
Snapshot metadata excludes pending from target matching. Changed pending is repaired in draft row P-1; at least one remaining prompt token establishes g/d0 before decode.
All target recurrent, attention/index/RoPE and draft effective ranges use the existing unchanged SessionStateRanges helper and destination slot offsets.
Cold same-scope concurrent requests can miss but cannot consume unpublished data. Success publishes; failure/cancel releases unpublished entries.
The shared 8 GiB byte bound includes an in-progress save under the same storage mutex. Eight entries and 32 leases bound metadata; at most four checkpoints per request.
Restoration read failure resets both models before fresh prefill; CUDA errors mark GPU unhealthy. Snapshot failure remains optional cache miss.
Ordinary requests without scope skip shared matching/checkpoint capture. Defaults and the installed 09fe program are unchanged.
Shared snapshots copy into independent slot state; this is compute reuse, not physical GPU KV page sharing or freeing reserved slot memory.
limits: Different fresh-prefill shapes can differ numerically; exact primary reference uses independently recomputed committed prefix and primitive one-row branch update.
No cross-process, model/head migration or arbitrary-token preemption.
RAM accounting must include driver staging and file/system caches; configured budget is not an isolated measured allocation delta.
